title: No Brainer Nifty Ratio
summary: Monthly Nifty ratio-style call structure with a last-Friday entry, defined capital-based target and stop, and capped debit/credit parameters alongside a three-leg CE diagram.
riskFirstNote: Respect the debit-on-downside and max-credit caps before entry; if the market does not fit the sheet, skip the trade.

image.alt: No Brainer Nifty Ratio strategy sheet with parameters and strike diagram

rules: Plan the full three-leg structure before the last Friday of the month; confirm monthly expiry and margin requirements.
Execute at the stated Friday time (3:16 PM) only if quotes and liquidity support the intended strikes and ratios.
Size positions so that target and stop-loss percentages refer to deployed capital, not notional exposure alone.
Honor the debit-on-downside and max-credit constraints from the sheet; if live quotes violate them, do not force the entry.
Document actual fills and adjust only within the playbook—no discretionary add-ons mid-trade.
riskNotes: Ratio structures can behave sharply around spot; gap risk and pin risk remain material.
A wider wing (1000 OTM) changes payoff shape; validate the structure with your broker’s margin simulator.
Late-week entries can face reduced liquidity; slippage may erode the intended risk/reward.
Skip if major scheduled events overlap the holding window unless your process explicitly allows them.
disclaimer: Educational content only; this is not investment advice.
Options involve substantial risk of loss.
Verify strikes, ratios, and margin with your broker and exchange before trading.
